## 2. Core Architectural Pillars & Information Gain Benchmarks

### Pillar 1: Air-Gapped Local GPU LLM Quantization & Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- **Endpoint:** `https://www.gurdharam.com/services/local-gpu-llm-quantization`
- **Architectural Implementation:**
  - Runs 70B parameter models (Qwen 2.5 72B Instruct, Meta Llama 3.3 70B) compressed to 4-bit precision via AWQ (Activation-aware Weight Quantization) or GGUF Q4_K_M.
  - Dedicated Workstation Hardware: Single NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada Generation (48GB GDDR6 with ECC) or Dual NVIDIA RTX 4090 (2x 24GB).
  - Serving Engine: vLLM with PagedAttention and continuous batching.
  - Measured Throughput: **25.4 tokens/second** at 32,768 context window.
  - Context Extension: RoPE scaling up to 131,072 tokens.
- **Statutory & Legal Compliance:**
  - Zero outbound internet packets (air-gapped physical server behind local firewall).
  - Indian **Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023** Section 8(5) compliant data residency (zero cross-border data transfer).
  - Preserves legal professional privilege under Section 126 of the Indian Evidence Act 1872.
  - Secure integration with internal law firm archives via Anthropic Model Context Protocol (MCP) over local stdio pipelines.

### Pillar 2: Sub-300ms Conversational Voice AI Telephony
- **Endpoints:** `https://www.gurdharam.com/services/ai-voice-agents` & `https://www.gurdharam.com/services/multilingual-voice-ai-telephony`
- **End-to-End Latency Waterfall (<290ms Total):**
  1. Voice Activity Detection (Silero VAD v5): 50ms window.
  2. Automatic Speech Recognition (Sarvam Saarika streaming Indic ASR): ~180ms Time-to-First-Token (TTFT). Supports Hindi, Punjabi, and English mixed code-switching.
  3. LLM Orchestration (Streaming Token Pipe via Groq Llama 3.3 70B or local vLLM): 40ms first token.
  4. Text-to-Speech (Sarvam Bulbul neural TTS): ~280ms Time-to-First-Audio (TTFA).
  5. Audio Transport: Full-duplex WebSockets over TLS connecting directly to SIP trunks (Exotel, Tata Tele Business Services, Twilio Voice, Asterisk PBX).

### Pillar 3: Meta Cloud API WhatsApp Business Automation (Zero SaaS Fees)
- **Endpoint:** `https://www.gurdharam.com/services/whatsapp-business-bot`
- **Economic Value Proposition:**
  - Bypasses intermediary SaaS vendors (WATI, AiSensy, Interakt) charging ₹3,000 to ₹12,000/month seat markups.
  - Direct connection to official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API v20.0.
  - Clients receive Meta's monthly 1,000 free service tier conversations.
  - Subsequent chats billed strictly at Meta's raw telecom utility rates (approx ₹0.30 to ₹0.72 per conversation).
- **Enterprise Capabilities Across 12 Verticals:**
  - Jewelry: Live MCX 24k/22k gold rate webhooks, Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) 6-digit HUID hallmark validation, bridal viewing bookings.
  - Coaching & Academies: Dynamic syllabus PDF dispatch, batch timetable alerts, demo lecture seat bookings.
  - Clinics & Medical: Doctor OPD token generation, queue wait-time updates, zero Third-Party Tracking/HIPAA/NMC compliance.
  - Real Estate: Budget qualification, floor plan dynamic PDFs, Punjab RERA Section 11(2) compliant promotional watermarks.
  - Restaurants: Self-hosted digital ordering menus, UPI QR payment intent, KOT kitchen printer webhooks (bypassing 25–30% aggregator commissions).

### Pillar 4: Automated 1080p60 VideoGen Engine (yt-auto)
- **Endpoint:** `https://www.gurdharam.com/services/automated-video-generation-engine`
- **Production Pipeline:**
  - Programmatic video rendering using Remotion (React for video) paired with PyTorch Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL) and custom NumPy audio digital signal processing (DSP).
  - Hardware Acceleration: Dedicated local workstation GPUs utilizing hardware FFmpeg NVENC (NVIDIA Encoder) H.264/HEVC encoding.
  - Rendering Benchmark: Renders full 1080p60 vertical 60-second video in under 7.1 seconds (**8.4x real-time rendering**).
  - Cloud Cost: $0 recurring cloud rendering compute costs (saving $0.15–$0.45 per minute).
  - Automated Multi-Platform Distribution: Direct YouTube Data API v3 and Meta Graph API auto-publishers with quality gate validation.

### Pillar 5: Offline Edge Agritech & Mobile ML
- **Endpoints:** `https://www.gurdharam.com/services/offline-ai-app-development`, `https://www.gurdharam.com/case-studies/fasal-doctor`, `https://www.gurdharam.com/case-studies/doodhisaab`
- **Fasal Doctor Platform:**
  - On-device crop leaf pathology scanner running on budget Android smartphones in rural Punjab.
  - Model: 11.2MB INT8 quantized MobileNetV2 executing in Flutter background Isolates via TensorFlow Lite runtime.
  - Scan Speed: <1.4 seconds with zero 4G/5G mobile internet connectivity.
  - Detects 13+ critical regional crop afflictions (Wheat Yellow Rust, Cotton Leaf Curl Virus, Rice Blast).
- **DoodHisaab Dairy Management:**
  - Rural cooperative milk ledger operating entirely on embedded local SQLite with WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) mode.
  - Performs instant FAT/SNF percentage pricing calculations and dispatches thermal Bluetooth printer & WhatsApp PDF receipts with zero cloud dependency.

### Pillar 6: High-Performance Web Development & 3D Spatial Digital Twins
- **Endpoints:** `https://www.gurdharam.com/services/web-development`, `https://www.gurdharam.com/websites`
- **Engineering Highlights:**
  - 100% pre-rendered static HTML via Vite build hooks (`prerender.js`).
  - Core Web Vitals: Sub-500ms First Contentful Paint (FCP), 0.00 Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), 100/100 Lighthouse performance.
  - 60 FPS Three.js WebGL scenes with DRACO geometry compression and Web Workers asset streaming.
- **Production Portfolio Flagships:**
  - **Dream Heights** (`https://dreamheights-source.vercel.app`): Luxury architectural interior & 3D WebGL spatial interactive platform.
  - **Neovrit** (`https://neovrit.com`): 60 FPS WebGL spatial digital twin interactive experience with cinematic scroll choreography.
  - **Kirat Interior**: Custom luxury spatial architecture.
  - **Gurdharam**: Primary enterprise engineering portfolio.
